functionalSummary: Created ESP32 PlatformIO project structure and unified protocol contract for MyActuator motor control library, establishing CAN bus and multi-protocol abstraction layer with contract-first development approach.
detailSummary: Created project structure and unified protocol contract for MyActuator ESP32 motor control library. The PROTOCOLS_CONTRACT.md defines an abstraction layer for CAN bus and other communication protocols, targeting ESP32 DevKitC and ESP32-S3 with PlatformIO build system. Directory structure organizes work into protocols, motor series (RMD-X, RH, CEM, RMD-H, RMD-L, FL-FLO), firmware (ESP32 and controllers), simulation (Three.js and STEP files), docs, and contracts. Contract-first approach ensures interfaces are defined before implementation. Sub-agents were spawned for firmware, motor-specific, and simulation contracts but task tracking failed, leaving their creation status unverified.
